title: Stats for Analysts
description: Build the statistical intuition every data analyst needs: probability rules, descriptive statistics, the normal distribution, z-scores, confidence intervals, and when to trust a metric. Conceptual and hands-on numerical questions combined.
outcomes: You will be able to compute and interpret mean, median, and standard deviation, apply basic probability rules, reason about the normal distribution and z-scores, and explain what a confidence interval actually means.
